purpose: Vita3K original DSO/TLS and exception-runtime execution; original nnosInitialize with native SVC services; constructor gate retained

patches.name: dso_enter
patches.abi: Observe r0-r3 plus 17 stack words, preserve LR/SP/guest frame, resume displaced PUSH and untouched original DSO body; never synthesize a DSO result

patches.name: ctor_gate
patches.abi: Abort before the first SDK constructor dispatch with bridge error -4/service 0x230; do not return to guest or mark constructors complete

patches.name: lock
patches.abi: r0=owned guest lock address; real SceKernelMutex acquire on owner thread, timeout is an error; no generic success

patches.name: unlock
patches.abi: r0=owned held guest lock address; real SceKernelMutex release; unknown/unowned mutex is an error

patches.name: exception_info
patches.abi: r0=owned 16-byte ExceptionInfo output, r1=PC; return bool r0; native module metadata only

patches.name: tls_normal
patches.abi: Original nn::os TLS slot API; real 32-slot pool, per-guest-thread values, normal limit 16, SDK searches downward

start_window.launch_block: 0x9000-byte NSO argument block (allocated size, string size, 0x18 reserved, command line); parsed by the original nnosInitialize

exception_index_policy.sorted_view: function address ascending, original-record offset as stable secondary key
exception_index_policy.prel31: rebase function and non-inline extab fields into private owned arena; preserve extab/personality targets
exception_index_policy.duplicates: last original record at equal start, matching locked SDK observation; diagnostic source lookup still rejects ambiguity
exception_index_policy.cantunwind: use checked unw_get_proc_info; _Unwind_Find_FDE discards errors and is not a negative-case oracle
